programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Lou Ferrigno (star of the 1970s/80s TV series The Incredible Hulk), Sybil Danning, Ingrid Anderson and Mirella D'Angelo take the lead roles in Italian writer-director Luigi Cozzi's mythological romp for the low-budget action specialists The Cannon Group. The narrative starts with the creation of the universe, at the end of which Pandora's jar is broken, releasing evil into the world. Greek god Zeus (Claudio Cassinelli) decides to protect mankind from evil by creating a hero and sends divine light down to Bronze Age Thebes, where it enters the body of a royal baby. The infant survives a bloody palace coup instigated by Adriana (Danning), daughter of a rival monarch, and the malicious interventions of Zeus's wronged wife Hera (Rossana Podestŕ) to become the immensely strong Hercules (Ferrigno). But adulthood doesn't see an end to the relentless campaign to destroy him. And when Adriana captures his love Cassiopea (Anderson), Hercules joins forces with the sorceress Circe (D'Angelo) to save Cassiopea.

programme.title: The Outsider
programme.desc: An investigation of a dead daughter begins when a military contractor Lex Walker (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles and he finds the body is not his daughter's. Lex Walker, a British mercenary battling in Afghanistan who drops everything to hurry to Los Angeles when he is informed that his daughter Samantha, who he has not seen in many years, has been found dead. When he arrives at the morgue to identify the body, he is for some reason unsurprised to discover that it is not hers. So he begins a one-man investigation into her whereabouts, trailed by the suspicious detective (Jason Patric) assigned to the case. He soon makes his way to Samantha's boss, Karl Schuster (James Caan), the millionaire CEO of a high-tech company who offers sympathy but little help. It quickly becomes obvious that Schuster is hiding something, since he displays no hesitation about shooting one of his henchmen to death in his own office. Aided by a sexy barmaid (Shannon Elizabeth) enticed by his offer of a $10,000 finder's fee, the take-no-prisoners Lex sets out getting to the bottom of the mystery, beating up or shooting the myriad human obstacles who get in his way. It all leads to his discovery of a massive identity-theft scheme engineered by Schuster about which Lex's very much alive daughter (Melissa Ordway) has the goods.

programme.title: Sherlock Homes: The Case of the Whitechapel Vampire
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson are called to Whitechapel after learning about a series of strange murders only two years after the Jack the Ripper murders in the same neighborhood. The local belief is that the killings are the work of a vampire brought back from a recent mission in Guyana. As they investigate the deaths, they engage in an ongoing debate about the supernatural, with Watson believing in the possibility of vampires and Holmes remaining skeptical until he is able to prove the murders are the works of a living human, rather than any undead creature. At one point, the investigation leads them to the psychic Madame Karasky, who says that Holmes will be saved by the church. Shortly thereafter, Holmes is pushed in front of a moving carriage by the supposed vampire, only to be saved by a pedestrian. In order to catch the murderer, Holmes disguises himself as a monk and reveals that the vampire was Brother Abel, who hoped to get revenge on the monks who didn't listen to him when he believed that the bats were causing rabies in the South American mission, when he was infected. The film ends at Baker Street, when Mrs. Hudson gives Holmes his pipe, delivered by the same man that saved Holmes from being run over. When Holmes asks his name, Mrs. Hudson says his name was Reginald Church.

programme.title: The Hot Potato
programme.desc: London's East End 1969. Based on real events. Two chancers "find" a lump of Uranium and crisscross Europe to find a buyer. Accompanied by Danny's girl,the lovely Carole. They encounter a diverse cast of bizarre characters, all trying to steal the 'Hot Potato', but a deal agreed inside the Vatican has the co-conspirators confounding each other. The story twists and turns to an exciting and unexpected finale.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: The story is about Kunal (Kunal Khemu) who believes he can do anything by trying his hardest. He receives a job offer through his friend Shawn (Teeshay) and his wife Nandini (Puja Gupta (actress)) in Cape Town and moves there with his wife Aarzoo (Amrita Puri). They live a happy life together, until Kunal becomes extremely workaholic. Kunal's nature irritates Aarzoo which leads to frequent outbursts and quarrels. Kunal becomes the most trusted employee of his boss Dharmesh Zaveri (Manish Chaudhary). This thing angers Dinesh Zaveri, Dharmesh Zaveri's younger brother. Kunal advances in his job. Soon Dharmesh is revealed to be an underworld gangster. The company Kunal works in deals with exporting diamonds; Kunal has no idea that it happens illegally. His boss, Mr. Zakaria, sends his hot colleague Rosa to charm Kunal and take him away from his wife. Following the day when Kunal gets drunk in a party, Rosa takes advantage and manages to make love with him. Kunal reaches his house and finds Aarzoo sleeping and accidentally wakes her up, after which they both pick up a quarrel. Soon enough, Kunal realises the crime he is a part of and decides to and leave Cape Town. However, Zakaria knows that Kunal is aware of the illegal business and the only way to keep him silent is to kill him.

programme.title: Sorority Wars
programme.desc: Katie Parker (Lucy Hale) and Sara Snow (Phoebe Strole) have been friends since childhood. They enter college together, where Katie is a prized legacy candidate for the Delta sorority, which was co-founded decades ago by her mother, Lutie (Courtney Thorne-Smith) and Summer (Faith Ford), whose own daughter Gwen (Amanda Schull) now leads the Deltas on campus. Events occur during pledge week to cause a rift between Katie and the Deltas, which leaves Sara as a Delta pledge and Katie out in the cold. Katie joins the rival Kappa sorority, and the rivalry splits not just Katie and Sara, but extends all the way into the Delta alumnae association led by Lutie and Summer.

programme.title: The Circuit
programme.desc: Al Shines, former king of the US race car track circuit, has a hard time starting his own team, once he's fired by his sponsor Robin Cates. Robin hired Al's immature daughter Kylie Shines instead. She resents Al's inevitable 'absence' as a widowed father, as well as the reigning champion, equally young but professionally vetted Kid Walker. Kylie tries to prove herself against Kid while having an on-off affair with him. Cates's marketing strategy dictates his intentions to manipulate Walker and both Shines racers.

programme.title: The Hollywood Mom's Mystery
programme.desc: Drama with Justine Bateman. Lucy Freers has a great life in the suburbs of Hollywood - until a neighbour is found dead in her swimming pool and Lucy must clear her family's name.

The movie is based on events that occurred in Taylor County, Georgia in 2002.

In order to catch the murderer, Holmes disguises himself as a monk and reveals that the vampire was Brother Abel, who hoped to get revenge on the monks who didn't listen to him when he believed that the bats were causing rabies in the South American mission, when he was infected. The film ends at Baker Street, when Mrs. Hudson gives Holmes his pipe, delivered by the same man that saved Holmes from being run over. When Holmes asks his name, Mrs. Hudson says his name was Reginald Church.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens - Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: Winter. Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: With leopards in its mountains, blue whales off its coasts, and foxes roaming its city centres, Europe is a continent full of wild surprises. From the frozen glaciers of Iceland to the lush islands of the Azores, and from the rugged peaks of the Caucasus to the metropolis of London, the first episode in this stunning series highlights Europe's astonishing diversity, all shot with breath-taking brio and the latest technology to reveal the continent and its animals in all its breath-taking glory.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Out There with Jack Randall
programme.desc: At the tender age of 14, Jack Randall left his home in the UK to work under the guidance of legendary wildlife expert Steve Irwin. Developing his skills of handling reptiles and snakes, Randall learned important skills under Irwin's tutelage that remain with him today. Now an accomplished zoologist, Randall is continuing his studies into wild and exotic species, visiting harsh landscapes and unrelenting environments to explore these animal's behaviours. Using his bold and courageous approach, Randall gets up close and personal with deadly snakes, vicious crocodiles, boisterous kangaroos, fierce camels and many other dangerous species.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: HOSTILE PLANET is a ground-breaking wildlife series that explores Earth's most hostile environments. Over the course of six episodes, we explore the extremes of deep, high, cold, hot, wet and dry and reveal the truly extraordinary ways in which animals have adapted to survive in the face of great adversity. It's always been a HOSTILE PLANET and yet, in the last 40 years, it's got a whole lot tougher for the wildlife. The world has changed more in the last 40 years than at any time in the last 65 million. So animals in the most hostile places on Earth must adapt in the blink of an evolutionary eye. Facing everything from intrinsically hostile habitats and brutally punishing weather to the unrelenting threat of predators and intense competition for resources, their challenge is simple: adapt or die.

programme.title: Australia's Wild Woodlands
programme.desc: "Australia's Wild Woodlands" explores the rich biodiversity and resilience of Australia's eucalyptus forests, home to the world's largest variety of parrots and iconic species like the platypus. These woodlands span vast regions and support diverse wildlife, from red kangaroos to freshwater crocodiles. The film showcases the rare behaviors of marsupials and birds, highlighting threats from climate change and land clearing. Ancient ecosystems remain largely unchanged since the dinosaurs, but species like the Gouldian finch face uncertain futures. Through intimate storytelling, the documentary reveals the ecological importance and fragility of these vibrant landscapes.

programme.title: Dolphins Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory is in the Azores, a marine sanctuary and vital pitstop for migrating ocean predators off the coast of Portugal. It's feeding season, as thousands of normally elusive predators join forces to hunt and feed on super-shoals of fish known as bait balls. A vast ocean and battling storms challenge the team for a chance to film the most spectacular feeding frenzy of Bertie's career.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a rich and diverse land. Stunning landscapes harbor elusive critters that have evolved to thrive here. But survival is not assured because the abundant prey is closely followed by powerful predators.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Gaze into the realm of gulpers: animals who waste no time eating their prey — often swallowing it whole. Something deadly lies silent in the leaf litter of West Africa. The Gaboon viper is loaded with the largest fangs and fastest strike of any snake. Further south, the solifuge, or sun spider, darts through the desert, seeking an unlucky bug to mince with its massive mandibles. Strange mouths are also in the ocean. The moray eel is a bizarre fish, but its most characteristic charm is hiding down its dark throat. These and more lie in store.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Examine the weirdest animals that hide deep beneath the soil's surface. A worm explodes from the seabed to yank fish into its mucky pit; a beetle tunnels deep into warm, wet dung; and a miniature digger excavates miles of tunnel with its teeth! Some hunt in swarms to overwhelm living prey, while solo operators rely on disguise and trickery to trap victims. Tunnellers display bizarre and ingenious solutions to survive in cramped, stuffy and dark conditions.

Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: HOSTILE PLANET is a ground-breaking wildlife series that explores Earth's most hostile environments. Over the course of six episodes, we explore the extremes of deep, high, cold, hot, wet and dry and reveal the truly extraordinary ways in which animals have adapted to survive in the face of great adversity. It's always been a HOSTILE PLANET and yet, in the last 40 years, it's got a whole lot tougher for the wildlife. The world has changed more in the last 40 years than at any time in the last 65 million. So animals in the most hostile places on Earth must adapt in the blink of an evolutionary eye. Facing everything from intrinsically hostile habitats and brutally punishing weather to the unrelenting threat of predators and intense competition for resources, their challenge is simple: adapt or die.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: Nuts to You/The Terror of Madagascar Description : Nuts to You: Fred the Squirrel has hit the jackpot. He stumbles onto a jackpot oak tree which is loaded with acorns (that's tons of money to animal folk). He's going to need financial advice, and who better to offer sound advice than King Julien? The two enter a partnership looking for ways to spend on the good life. The Red Squirrel has designs on the loot, though, and captures the hapless twosome in order to squeeze the acorns out of them. Will the evil squirrel's precisely planned plot pay or get him played? The Terror of Madagascar: A special delivery has come from Madagascar. What is it? A baby Fossa! Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: 10-year-old Hazel Wells has just moved to Dimmadelphia with her family and is struggling with the change. On top of that, her beloved brother, Antony, is away at his first year of college and Hazel is feeling lonely without him. When she has a rocky start at her new school and Antony has to cancel a visit, Hazel tries to run away to visit Antony.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda must pass Wish Trials in Fairy World to prove they're a match. Hazel crumbles under pressure, struggling to make a wish confidently, which leads to Cosmo and Wanda failing to grant her half-formed wishes. Consequently, Jorgen reassigns Hazel to a boisterous, no-nonsense fairy named Cookie, who only cares about efficiency, not accuracy. Displeased with the cookie-cutter nature of Cookie's magic, Hazel must find a way to confidently wish for Cosmo and Wanda to be her fairies again. // Intimidated by her new classmates, Hazel wishes to be friends with the teachers instead. Once her wish is granted, she and the teachers play around the schoolyard and neglect to prep for the big test coming up. When test day arrives, Hazel realizes her wish has decreased the teachers' maturity. They're acting like little kids! Hazel has to make a choice-keep her teacher friends and let the whole school fail or change them back and brave making new friends the hard way.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel wishes to meet a dinosaur. Cosmo and Wanda bring Bary, a Baryonyx from the Cretaceous period, to present day. Hazel makes wishes to find Bary a job but unfortunately, Bary never quite fits in. Worse, his giant dinosaur tail knocks out power to the whole city, ruining Dimmadelphia's prized Electric Light Ice Cream Float Parade. With Hazel feeling remorseful, Bary musters inspiration from his hero, the great Thomas Rex-ison, and uses his dinosaur smarts to try to save the day. // Hazel has planned a night of watching scary movies with her new friend, Jasmine, but it turns out Jasmine hates scary movies. programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish

At first, she is wrapped up in the thrill of solving a mystery, but things get real when the landlord goes missing. Everyone is a suspect - kids at school, the strange new neighbors, and even Cosmo and Wanda! Things intensify when Hazel suspects her family is the next target. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

It's a mystery-aboard-a-train story as SpongeBob tries to locate the culprit, and he does it with the unlikeliest of allies ... Plankton! Now Squidward has to sit next to SpongeBob in class all day long and SpongeBob couldn't be happier! He recruits SpongeBob as his writer, but SpongeBob doesn't feel comfortable making up stories about other people because that would make him a liar. But Mr. Krabs assures him that making up stories for the paper isn't lying, it's using your imagination! SpongeBob discovers that making up stories about the people in Bikini Bottom is a lot of fun-but the people he's writing about don't think so.

programme.title: La Liga. Barselonos „Espanyol“ - Cheronos „Girona“
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Paryžiaus „Saint-Germain“ - Lilio OSC
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: In occasione dell'uscita in sala del nuovo film di Massimiliano Bruno, Francesco Castelnuovo intervista il protagonista maschile, Edoardo Leo, che ci racconta aneddoti dal set.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume: La danza dello squalo
programme.desc: Il pericolo è in mare nel 30esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Uno squalo terrorizza Pineta, mentre il BarLume brulica di amori incrociati e complotti.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume: La danza dello squalo
programme.desc: Il pericolo è in mare nel 30esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Uno squalo terrorizza Pineta, mentre il BarLume brulica di amori incrociati e complotti.

programme.title: Elephant white
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon e Djimon Hounsou in un action ambientato in Thailandia. Un killer, ingaggiato per sterminare una gang che opera nella prostituzione minorile, scopre una rete di bugie.

programme.title: Ti Odio, Ti Lascio, Ti...
programme.desc: Commedia romantica con Vince Vaughn e Jennifer Aniston. Dopo l'ennesimo diverbio, Gary e Brooke decidono di lasciarsi ma nessuno dei due e' intenzionato ad abbandonare il tetto coniugale.

programme.title: Quattro chiacchiere con Paola Cortellesi
programme.desc: L’attrice e regista si racconta a Gianni Canova: dagli esordi musicali al teatro, passando per la TV fino ad arrivare al cinema.

programme.title: Berlinguer - La grande ambizione
programme.desc: Elio Germano, diretto da Andrea Segre, nel biopic su uno dei grandi protagonisti della Prima Repubblica. Il film rilegge un pezzo della nostra storia, e sullo sfondo degli anni 70 ripercorre la vita privata e la militanza politica del leader del Partito Comunista Italiano.

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Cailee Spaeny nella pellicola di Sofia Coppola che racconta il grande e turbolento amore tra Priscilla Beaulieu e il re del rock and roll Elvis Presley (Jacob Elordi).

programme.title: Unbroken
programme.desc: Sceneggiato dai fratelli Coen, war movie biografico di Angelina Jolie. Seconda guerra mondiale: reclutato in aviazione, l'atleta Louis Zamperini finisce in mano ai giapponesi nel Pacifico.

programme.title: I mostri
programme.desc: Dino Risi dirige Vittorio Gassman e Ugo Tognazzi in uno dei manifesti della Commedia all'Italiana: un affresco dell'Italia degli anni 60 in venti memorabili episodi sul filo del grottesco.

programme.title: First Man - Il primo uomo
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling e' Neil Armstrong nel biopic di Damien Chazelle premiato con 1 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe. America, anni 60: la storia della missione spaziale che porto' alla conquista della Luna.

programme.title: Il miglio verde
programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel dramma carcerario tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. 1935: un gigantesco uomo di colore, dotato di poteri curativi, viene condannato a morte per omicidio.

programme.title: Gomorra: Le origini
programme.desc: Angelo è costretto ad accettare un accordo e si fa aiutare da Pietro per metterlo in pratica. Ma non tutto è come sembra. Con sottotitoli.

programme.title: September 5 - La diretta che cambiò la storia
programme.desc: Il ritmo serrato del thriller per ripercorrere uno storico evento mediatico. 1972: durante le Olimpiadi di Monaco di Baviera, un commando palestinese uccide due atleti israeliani e ne prende in ostaggio nove. Una troupe della ABC documenta i drammatici eventi in tempo reale.

programme.desc: Angelo è costretto ad accettare un accordo e si fa aiutare da Pietro per metterlo in pratica. Ma non tutto è come sembra. Con sottotitoli.

programme.title: Eyes Wide Shut
programme.desc: Nicole Kidman e Tom Cruise nell'ultimo capolavoro di Stanley Kubrick che scava nell'intimità di una coppia. Un uomo perde ogni certezza quando la moglie gli svela i suoi sogni proibiti.

programme.title: Speciale - Gomorra - Le Origini
programme.desc: Tutti i segreti del dietro le quinte di Gomorra Le Origini, la serie che racconta l’iniziazione criminale di Pietro Savastano.

programme.title: First Man - Il primo uomo
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling e' Neil Armstrong nel biopic di Damien Chazelle premiato con 1 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe. America, anni 60: la storia della missione spaziale che porto' alla conquista della Luna.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: Reagan: Un Presidente sotto i riflettori
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid, Penelope Ann Miller e Jon Voight nel biopic che ripercorre la vita privata e politica di Ronald Reagan, Presidente degli Stati Uniti negli anni 80. Dall'infanzia in Illinois, alla carriera hollywoodiana fino al palcoscenico mondiale come capo della Casa Bianca.

programme.title: Ufficiale e gentiluomo
programme.desc: Due Oscar e Due Golden Globe al cult anni 80 che ha lanciato Richard Gere. Il ribelle Zack si iscrive all'accademia per piloti di jet, ma sul suo cammino trova un sadico istruttore.

programme.title: September 5 - La diretta che cambiò la storia
programme.desc: Il ritmo serrato del thriller per ripercorrere uno storico evento mediatico. 1972: durante le Olimpiadi di Monaco di Baviera, un commando palestinese uccide due atleti israeliani e ne prende in ostaggio nove. Una troupe della ABC documenta i drammatici eventi in tempo reale.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: Il grande Steven Spielberg dirige i premi Oscar Anthony Hopkins e Morgan Freeman in un appassionante dramma storico-giudiziario. 1839: un gruppo di schiavi, imbarcati sulla nave Amistad per essere venduti, si ribellano e uccidono parte dell'equipaggio tentando il dirottamento verso l'Africa. Giunti su un'isola verranno pero' attaccati da una nave americana rischiando di essere schiavizzati ancora. Seconda nomination agli Oscar per Anthony Hopkins nel ruolo di un Presidente degli Stati Uniti (qui interpreta John Q. Adams) dopo quella ottenuta per "Nixon".

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: Il socio
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di John Grisham, thriller di Sydney Pollack con Gene Hackman e Tom Cruise. Assunto da un prestigioso studio legale, un avvocato inesperto viene coinvolto in loschi intrighi.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: La luce sugli oceani
programme.desc: Michael Fassbender e Alicia Vikander in un dramma sulla pericolosa scelta di una coppia. Un guardiano del faro e sua moglie salvano una neonata alla deriva e la crescono in segreto.

programme.title: Salvate il soldato Ryan
programme.desc: 5 Oscar per il film di guerra firmato Steven Spielberg, con Tom Hanks e Matt Damon. Dopo lo sbarco in Normandia, un plotone va in cerca dell'unico soldato superstite di quattro fratelli.

programme.title: Povere creature!
programme.desc: Londra XIX secolo: una donna morta suicida nel Tamigi viene riportata in vita da uno scienziato. Bramosa di conoscere e totalmente libera, la rediviva creatura inizia un instancabile percorso di formazione e di emancipazione.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: Fuori
programme.desc: Valeria Golino, Elodie e Matilda De Angelis, premiate con il Nastro d'Argento, nel film di Mario Martone dal romanzo autobiografico di Goliarda Sapienza. 1980: in carcere, la scrittrice instaura un legame di sorellanza con due detenute che continua quando le donne ritrovano la libertà.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Eden
programme.desc: Diretto da Ron Howard, un avvincente thriller basato su una storia vera con Jude Law e Vanessa Kirby. Dopo la crisi del 1929, il dottore e filosofo Friedrich Ritter decide di lasciare la Germania e di trasferirsi in un'isola remota delle Galapagos.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Negli Stati Uniti infuocati da una sanguinosa guerra civile, Kirsten Dunst è la coraggiosa fotografa Lee che, insieme ad una collega e due giornalisti, intraprende un rischioso viaggio da New York a Washington per intervistare il Presidente.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: Giurato numero 2
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: Per qualche dollaro in piu'
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo restaurato della trilogia western di Sergio Leone con Clint Eastwood e Gian Maria Volontè. Due pistoleri braccano un bandito messicano sul quale pende una grossa taglia.

programme.title: Nata per te
programme.desc: Sky Original ispirato a una storia vera e piena d'amore diretta da Fabio Mollo. Luca, single e omosessuale con un forte desiderio di paternita', lotta per ottenere l’affidamento di Alba.

programme.title: Mi chiamo Francesco Totti
programme.desc: Francesco Totti si racconta nel documentario di Alex Infascelli. Nella notte che precede l'addio al calcio, il capitano della Roma ripercorre le emozioni della sua vita privata e sportiva.

programme.title: Maria Regina di Scozia
programme.desc: Saoirse Ronan e Margot Robbie in un biopic alla corte d'Inghilterra. Maria Stuarda lascia la corona di Francia e torna in patria per rivendicare il trono su cui siede Elisabetta I.

programme.title: Io sono ancora qui
programme.desc: Walter Salles dirige Fernanda Torres in una storia vera premiata a Venezia e con l'Oscar 2025. Brasile, 1971: un giorno, all'improvviso, Rubens Paiva viene prelevato da casa.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: 3 Oscar, 3 Golden Globe e Leone d'argento alla regia di Brady Corbet che dirige Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones e Guy Pearce. Un architetto ebreo e sua moglie, sopravvissuti all'Olocausto, lasciano l'Ungheria per emigrare negli Stati Uniti. Un facoltoso cliente cambierà le loro vite.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al thriller diretto e interpretato da Ben Affleck. Iran, 1979: uno specialista della Cia attua un geniale piano per liberare un gruppo di ostaggi.

programme.title: Barry Seal - Una storia americana
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Domhnall Gleeson in un action tratto da una storia vera. Un pilota accusato di narcotraffico viene reclutato dalla Cia per svolgere missioni sotto copertura in Centro America.

programme.title: Il quinto potere
programme.desc: Il fenomeno WikiLeaks nel thriller biografico con Benedict Cumberbatch. La storia della piattaforma online e del suo fondatore Julian Assange che ha fatto tremare i governi del mondo.

programme.title: Anora
programme.desc: 5 Oscar e Palma d'oro a Cannes alla travolgente commedia di Sean Baker con Mikey Madison e Mark Eydelshteyn. Una spogliarellista di New York sposa il figlio miliardario di un oligarca russo, ma i suoceri inviano i loro sgherri negli Stati Uniti per annullare il matrimonio.

programme.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
programme.desc: Joaquin Phoenix riveste i panni del folle personaggio della DC Comics in uno sbalorditivo sequel con Lady Gaga. Internato nel manicomio di Arkham in attesa del processo per i crimini commessi, Arthur Fleck si innamora di Lee Quinzel, una paziente affascinata dalla figura del Joker.

programme.title: Giochi di potere
programme.desc: Harrison Ford nel thriller dal romanzo di Tom Clancy. In vacanza a Londra, l'agente della CIA Jack Ryan sventa un attentato dell'IRA ma viene braccato dal fratello di un terrorista.

programme.title: Sotto il segno del pericolo
programme.desc: Ritorna Harrison Ford nei panni di Jack Ryan nel terzo film dai romanzi di spionaggio di Tom Clancy. L'agente sfida una banda di narcotrafficanti colombiani protetti dal governo americano.

programme.title: Al vertice della tensione
programme.desc: Thriller con Ben Affleck e Morgan Freeman nel quarto film basato su Jack Ryan, il personaggio creato da Tom Clancy. Il giovane analista della CIA deve fermare un gruppo di terroristi.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: L'iniziazione
programme.desc: Chris Pine nella quinta pellicola della saga nata dalla penna di Tom Clancy. Ryan vola a Mosca per sventare un folle piano terroristico che farebbe crollare l'economia statunitense.

programme.desc: Secondo capitolo della trilogia di Robert Zemeckis con Michael J. Fox e Christopher Lloyd. Marty e Doc volano nel 2015, innescando una serie di eventi che cambieranno anche il passato.

programme.title: Blade: Trinity
programme.desc: Wesley Snipes, Ryan Reynolds e Jessica Biel nel terzo capitolo della saga. Con l'aiuto dei Nightstalkers, Blade affronta Drake, una creatura che può resistere alla luce del sole.

programme.title: Blade
programme.desc: Wesley Snipes nei panni dell’eroe della Marvel in un horror apocalittico. Blade, guerriero metropolitano dal sangue infetto, deve sterminare una stirpe di vampiri che vuole conquistare il mondo.

programme.title: Blade II
programme.desc: Il cacciatore di vampiri Wesley Snipes, ispirato a un fumetto della Marvel Comics, torna in un secondo episodio sempre più ricco di d'azione e combattimenti. Questa volta dovrà vedersela con un terribile nemico, Jared Nomak, a capo di una nuova e più spietata razza di mutanti che fa strage di uomini e di vampiri per dominare il mondo. Solo la precaria alleanza proprio con i vampiri, che Blade ha sempre combattuto. potrà dare una speranza all'umanità. Fra discoteche e fogne, la caccia al mutante è aperta, ma Blade scoprirà una verità sconcertante.

programme.desc: Keanu Reeves torna a vestire i panni del killer nel sequel con Riccardo Scamarcio e Claudia Gerini. Un debito con un boss camorrista costringe John Wick a impugnare nuovamente le armi.

programme.title: Immortals
programme.desc: Action sulla lotta tra umani e divinità con Henry Cavill e Stephen Dorff. Il giovane Teseo è scelto da Zeus per fermare il piano di Iperione: scatenare i titani contro gli dei.

programme.title: Shark - Il primo squalo
programme.desc: Jason Statham in un action ambientato negli abissi. Un esperto in missioni impossibili deve salvare un team di esploratori da un megalodonte, una specie estinta milioni di anni fa.

programme.title: Basic
programme.desc: Action di John McTiernan con John Travolta, Connie Nielsen e Samuel L. Jackson. Diventato agente della Narcotici, un ex militare indaga sulla misteriosa scomparsa di un temuto sergente.

programme.title: Extraction
programme.desc: Bruce Willis ostaggio dei terroristi in un action adrenalinico. Un ex agente della CIA viene rapito. Suo figlio lancerà un'operazione di salvataggio che svelerà un complotto internazionale.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Spettacolare blockbuster di Guillermo Del Toro con Idris Elba e Charlie Hunnam. Due coraggiosi piloti devono salvare il destino del pianeta Terra, minacciato da gigantesche creature aliene.

programme.title: Repo Men
programme.desc: Adrenalinico action fantascientifico con Jude Law e Forest Whitaker. In un futuro in cui è possibile comprare sofisticati organi artificiali, i Repo Men fanno visita a chi non paga.

programme.title: Speciale - Gomorra - Le Origini
programme.desc: Tutti i segreti del dietro le quinte di Gomorra Le Origini, la serie che racconta l’iniziazione criminale di Pietro Savastano.

programme.title: Redemption Day
programme.desc: Gary Dourdan in un action con Andy Garcia. Di ritorno da una missione contro l'Isis, un ufficiale, devastato dagli orrori bellici, deve salvare la moglie rapita da un gruppo terroristico.

programme.title: Marnie
programme.desc: La sublime regia di Alfred Hitchcock per un thriller psicologico con Tippi Hedren e Sean Connery. Un giovane industriale scava nel passato della moglie traumatizzata...

programme.title: La casa del terrore
programme.desc: Teen horror prodotto da Eli Roth. Halloween: sei ragazzi entrano in una casa adibita a escape room e si ritrovano prigionieri di una banda di aguzzini, ossessionati da una pratica macabra.

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Un implacabile conto alla rovescia scandisce un thriller con Elizabeth Lail. Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

programme.title: God is a Bullet
programme.desc: Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Maika Monroe e Jamie Foxx nel film Sky Original di Nick Cassavetes. Per salvare la figlia, il detective Bob Hightower si infiltra in una setta satanica.

programme.title: Speak No Evil - Non parlare con gli sconosciuti
programme.desc: James McAvoy e Mackenzie Davis in un thriller psicologico, remake dell'omonimo film danese. Una coppia americana accetta l'invito di due ambigui coniugi inglesi conosciuti in vacanza. Durante un inquietante weekend in campagna, i padroni di casa rivelano il loro vero volto.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Thriller psicologico con Sarah Paulson e Keira Allen. Costretta su una sedia a rotelle, la giovane Chloe scopre che le amorevoli cure di sua madre nascondono una verita' inaspettata.

programme.title: La memoria dell'assassino
programme.desc: Thriller-noir di e con Michael Keaton e con James Marsden e Al Pacino. Affetto da una malattia incurabile, un killer decide di mettere ordine nella sua vita prima di ritirarsi.

programme.title: Nodo alla gola
programme.desc: Dopo aver compiuto un omicidio due amici danno una cena sicuri di non venire scoperti. Ma tra gli invitati qualcuno sospetta di loro. Straordinario esercizio di stile del re del brivido: un film girato in un unico piano sequenza.

programme.title: La casa del terrore
programme.desc: Teen horror prodotto da Eli Roth. Halloween: sei ragazzi entrano in una casa adibita a escape room e si ritrovano prigionieri di una banda di aguzzini, ossessionati da una pratica macabra.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult e Willem Dafoe nel remake di un classico dell'horror gotico, diretto da Robert Eggers. Un agente immobiliare viene inviato nei Carpazi, nello spettrale castello di un ambiguo conte, ossessionato dalla sposa del suo ospite.

programme.title: God is a Bullet
programme.desc: Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Maika Monroe e Jamie Foxx nel film Sky Original di Nick Cassavetes. Per salvare la figlia, il detective Bob Hightower si infiltra in una setta satanica.

programme.title: Tafanos
programme.desc: Insetti assassini nella divertente produzione originale Sky che rende omaggio ai B-movie degli anni '70. Un gruppo di amici usa un metodo 'stupefacente' per difendersi da un pericolo mortale.

programme.title: Assassinio sull'Orient Express
programme.desc: Kenneth Branagh dirige un super cast con Michelle Pfeiffer, Penelope Cruz e Johnny Depp. Il detective Poirot indaga su un omicidio avvenuto su un treno. Dal bestseller di Agatha Christie.

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Carice van Houten e Guy Pearce in un thriller di Brian De Palma. Due agenti di Copenaghen, sulle tracce di un killer, vengono coinvolti in un intrigo internazionale.

programme.title: Humane
programme.desc: Il primo film della figlia d'arte Caitlin Cronenberg è una satira distopica con Jay Baruchel. La Terra è sull’orlo del collasso quando una cena di famiglia finisce nel caos.

programme.title: Fino alla fine
programme.desc: Gabriele Muccino torna alla regia con un thriller coinvolgente. In vacanza in Italia, Sophie incontra Giulio e decide di seguirlo, ma la nottata prenderà una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: The Wasp
programme.desc: Naomie Harris e Natalie Dormer, una delle star de "Il Trono di Spade", in un intricato thriller psicologico dalla suspense serrata. Stufa di subire le prepotenze del marito, Heather ricontatta dopo molti anni una ex compagna di scuola per proporle di uccidere l'uomo.

programme.title: The Prestige
programme.desc: Meraviglia e suspense con Hugh Jackman e Christian Bale, per la regia di Christopher Nolan. La Londra di fine 800 fa da sfondo all'accesa e ossessiva rivalita' tra due illusionisti.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Mary J. Blige in un thriller avvolto in un pauroso mistero. Un’agente di polizia di Los Angeles indaga sull’inspiegabile morte di un collega, avvenuta durante un controllo di routine. Il suo unico indizio è un filmato che lascia supporre l’esistenza di una creatura soprannaturale.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Thriller con Kevin Costner, Gary Oldman e Ryan Reynolds. La memoria di un defunto agente della CIA, in possesso di informazioni top secret, viene trasferita nella mente di un detenuto.

programme.title: Assassinio sull'Orient Express
programme.desc: Kenneth Branagh dirige un super cast con Michelle Pfeiffer, Penelope Cruz e Johnny Depp. Il detective Poirot indaga su un omicidio avvenuto su un treno. Dal bestseller di Agatha Christie.

programme.title: Caddo Lake
programme.desc: Thriller ricco di suspense con Dylan O'Brien, prodotto da M. Night Shyamalan. Quando la piccola Anna scompare misteriosamente nei pressi di un lago, inizia una disperata ricerca.

programme.title: Cena con delitto - Knives Out
programme.desc: Daniel Craig e un super cast in una movimentata commedia-thriller. Un detective indaga sulla famiglia di un ricco scrittore per scoprirne l'assassino.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.title: L'evocazione - The Conjuring
programme.desc: Patrick Wilson e Vera Farmiga nel primo capitolo della saga horror su una coppia di indagatori dell'occulto, che entrano in azione per fermare una terribile strega nel New England degli anni 70. La famiglia Perron - padre, madre e cinque figlie femmine - si e' appena trasferita in una nuova casa in campagna dove sono stati accolti da rumori inquietanti e strane apparizioni, che ben presto degenerano in vere e proprie manifestazioni paranormali. Terrorizzati, i coniugi Perron chiedono aiuto a due investigatori specializzati nella lotta contro presenze demoniache.

programme.title: Body Cam

programme.desc: Jon Voight e Burt Reynolds nel cult di John Boorman. Un weekend nella natura degli Appalachi si trasforma in un incubo da cui quattro amici cercano di fuggire.

programme.title: Synchronic
programme.desc: Anthony Mackie e Jamie Dornan in un fanta-thriller allucinato. New Orleans: una droga sintetica conduce chi ne fa uso dentro un incubo spaventoso. Un paramedico decide di sperimentare la sostanza su di sé, finendo per vagare in una realtà totalmente alterata.

programme.title: Monolith
programme.desc: Thriller Sky tratto dall'omonima graphic novel. Sola nel deserto, una donna deve liberare il figlio intrappolato in una macchina blindata.

programme.title: Cena con delitto - Knives Out
programme.desc: Daniel Craig e un super cast in una movimentata commedia-thriller. Un detective indaga sulla famiglia di un ricco scrittore per scoprirne l'assassino.

programme.desc: Al Pacino e Alicia Witt in un thriller mozzafiato diretto da Jon Avnet. Una misteriosa telefonata costringe uno psichiatra forense a una disperata corsa contro il tempo.

programme.desc: Geniale thriller di Alfred Hitchcock con James Stewart e Doris Day. Una coppia in vacanza in Marocco riceve confidenze top secret da un agente colpito a morte. Oscar per la migliore canzone.

programme.desc: John Krasinski dirige e interpreta l'horror rivelazione con Emily Blunt. Una famiglia e' costretta a vivere senza fare alcun rumore per salvarsi dai mostri che hanno invaso la Terra.

programme.title: Scomparsa
programme.desc: Amanda Seyfried a caccia dell'assassino in un thriller psicologico. Tornata a casa dal lavoro Jill scopre che sua sorella, Molly, e' stata rapita. Come poteva accadere a lei un anno prima, quando riusci' a fuggire dal misterioso aggressore che adesso sembra tornato in azione. Gia', perche' Jill e' convinta che dietro la scomparsa della sorella ci sia la stessa persona. Considerata paranoica dalla polizia, Jill non ha altra scelta per uscire da quest'incubo: indagare da sola per trovare il rapitore di sua sorella prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.desc: Clive Owen, Denzel Washington e Jodie Foster in un thriller di Spike Lee. Una banda di rapinatori irrompe in una banca di New York. Un detective tratta la liberazione degli ostaggi.

programme.desc: Thriller voyeuristico con Carolina Sala, opera prima di Domenico Croce. Una ragazza che vive isolata nella sua stanza si convince che nel palazzo di fronte si sia consumato un crimine.

programme.desc: Parker Finn dirige Naomi Scott nel perturbante secondo capitolo della saga horror. Una giovane popstar, perseguitata da esasperanti allucinazioni e divorata dalla paura, deve trovare una via di fuga da una terrificante entità maligna con il potere di spostarsi di persona in persona.

programme.title: A Quiet Place - Un posto tranquillo
programme.desc: John Krasinski dirige e interpreta l'horror rivelazione con Emily Blunt. Una famiglia e' costretta a vivere senza fare alcun rumore per salvarsi dai mostri che hanno invaso la Terra.

programme.title: High Ground
programme.desc: Un misterioso nuovo detenuto finisce nella prigione di una città di frontiera. Lo sceriffo del posto si ritrova a dover affrontare l'ira di un brutale cartello della droga, che agisce senza pietà.

programme.title: Io sono leggenda
programme.desc: Cult di fantascienza con Will Smith. Un virus ha decimato l'umanita' trasformando i superstiti in mostri. Uno scienziato immune al morbo studia una cura nel suo laboratorio.

programme.title: Crawl - Intrappolati
programme.desc: Durante un uragano, Haley ignora gli ordini di evacuazione per cercare il padre scomparso. Dopo averlo trovato gravemente ferito nella casa di famiglia, i due rimangono intrappolati dalle acque e da un branco di giganteschi alligatori.

programme.title: La donna che visse due volte
programme.desc: Il tema del doppio in un thriller diabolico di Alfred Hitchcock con James Stewart e Kim Novak. Incaricato di sorvegliare una donna enigmatica, un detective scivola in una spirale di follia.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman e Antonio Banderas in un thriller mozzafiato. Un esperto ladro internazionale recluta un giovane 'collega' per mettere a segno l'ultimo colpo della sua carriera.

programme.title: Inside Man
programme.desc: Clive Owen, Denzel Washington e Jodie Foster in un thriller di Spike Lee. Una banda di rapinatori irrompe in una banca di New York. Un detective tratta la liberazione degli ostaggi.

programme.title: Split
programme.desc: M. Night Shyamalan dirige un formidabile James McAvoy. Tre ragazze vengono rapite da un maniaco con 23 diverse personalità, ma la più pericolosa è ancora nascosta nella sua psiche.

programme.title: Songbird
programme.desc: Prodotto da Michael Bay, un thriller che immagina un drammatico futuro. 2024: le continue mutazioni del Covid-19 hanno chiuso il mondo in un eterno lockdown. In questo scenario da incubo, Nico, immune al virus, è pronto a infrangere la legge per liberare la sua fidanzata dall'isolamento.

programme.title: State a casa
programme.desc: Roan Johnson dirige una dark comedy dal ritmo incalzante con Tommaso Ragno e Dario Aita. Roma: costretti dalla pandemia da Covid-19 a una convivenza forzata nell’appartamento che condividono, quattro ragazzi in difficoltà economica saranno travolti da una nefasta spirale di eventi.

programme.title: In fondo al bosco
programme.desc: Prodotto da Sky Cinema, un thriller di Stefano Lodovichi. Tommi scompare durante una festa. Anni dopo viene ritrovato un bambino con lo stesso DNA ma la madre non lo riconosce.

programme.title: Psyco
programme.desc: Lezione di suspense e paura per la regia di Alfred Hitchcock, con Anthony Perkins, Vera Miles e Janet Leigh. Una donna in fuga arriva nel tetro motel gestito dall'inquietante Norman Bates.

programme.title: American Gigolo
programme.desc: Il film cult degli anni '80 che ha consacrato il mito sexy di Richard Gere. Un affascinante gigolo' finisce nei guai quando una delle sue clienti viene ritrovata barbaramente uccisa.

programme.title: Marilyn ha gli occhi neri
programme.desc: Stefano Accorsi e Miriam Leone in una commedia sentimentale. Come terapia riabilitativa, una bugiarda compulsiva e un uomo irascibile dovranno gestire insieme un ristorante.

programme.title: Pane e burlesque
programme.desc: Laura Chiatti e Sabrina Impacciatore in una piccante commedia a tinte rosa. Un paesino del Sud, in crisi e affollato di cassaintegrati dopo la chiusura della fabbrica di ceramiche, viene scosso dall'arrivo di Mimi' la Petite e della sua compagnia di burlesque. Il loro destino si intreccia con quello di Matilde e Teresa, in cerca di un'occasione perche' anche la merceria dove lavorano accusa le difficolta' economiche. Mimi', pero', e' arrivata in citta' anche per un altro motivo: e' infatti la figlia del proprietario della fabbrica e deve vendere le proprieta' di famiglia.

programme.title: Qualcosa di nuovo
programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia romantica di Cristina Comencini. Due amiche di vecchia data, e molto diverse tra loro, si contendono l’amore per uno sconosciuto.

programme.desc: Dakota Johnson in una pellicola sulla scoperta della sessualità. Dopo una serie di appuntamenti fallimentari con uomini, Lucy realizza che dipende da ciò che vuole veramente.

programme.desc: Sharon Stone in una pellicola di Pupi Avati con Riccardo Scamarcio. Dopo il suicidio del padre scrittore, il figlio tenta di pubblicarne il libro incompiuto scoprendo scottanti verita'.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jane Austen, una storia di intese amorose con Gwyneth Paltrow. 1800: una giovane aristocratica inglese aiuta una ragazza timida a trovare l'uomo giusto. Oscar alle musiche.

programme.title: L'amore e altre seghe mentali
programme.desc: Commedia romantica di e con Giampaolo Morelli e Maria Chiara Giannetta. Dopo una delusione d'amore Guido è diventato cinico, ma l'incontro con Giulia potrebbe fargli cambiare idea.

programme.desc: Romantica commedia natalizia con Denise Richards e Patrick Muldoon. Alla vigilia di Natale, Amy scopre di dover gestire insieme al suo ex fidanzato una panetteria ricevuta in eredita'.

programme.title: Qualcosa di nuovo
programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia romantica di Cristina Comencini. Due amiche di vecchia data, e molto diverse tra loro, si contendono l’amore per uno sconosciuto.

programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Venezia a Nicole Kidman in un dramma erotico con Harris Dickinson e Antonio Banderas. Una donna sposata, amministratice delegata di un'azienda importante, inizia una relazione clandestina con un giovane stagista che la trascina in una spirale di perversione.

programme.desc: Michelle Pfeiffer e Paul Rudd in una commedia romantica. La quarantenne divorziata Rosie, sceneggiatrice di una serie tv, si infatua di un affascinante attore molto più giovane di lei.

programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sofia Coppola per una raffinata commedia romantica con Bill Murray e Scarlett Johansson. A Tokyo per uno spot, un divo americano in declino farà un incontro speciale.

programme.desc: Franck Dubosc e Alexandra Lamy in una commedia romantica. Jocelyn, dongiovanni impenitente, non si ferma davanti a niente quando vuole sedurre una donna. Egoista e bugiardo, finge di essere disabile per conquistare la bella Marie. La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Diretto dallo stesso Franck Dubosc, al suo esordio dietro la macchina da presa.

programme.desc: Meg Ryan e Tom Hanks in un classico della commedia romantica. La proprietaria di una libreria flirta in rete con uno sconosciuto. Scoprira' che si tratta del suo rivale in affari.

programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: La rivolta delle ex
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.desc: Dal regista di "Famiglia all'improvviso", un'incantevole commedia romantica con Francois Civil e Joséphine Japy. Un famoso romanziere si risveglia in un mondo parallelo e capisce di dover riconquistare Olivia, la donna che ama e che ha già sposato nella sua vita originale.

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.desc: Nino Manfredi, Vittorio Gassman e Stefania Sandrelli nel capolavoro di Ettore Scola. La storia di tre amici, ex partigiani, sullo sfondo dell'Italia dal Dopoguerra agli anni 70. Dopo la fine del conflitto Gianni, Antonio e Nicola (Stefano Satta Flores) hanno preso strade diverse: Antonio fa il portantino e Nicola il professore, mentre Gianni è l’unico dei tre che è riuscito a fare carriera. Dopo molti anni, per caso, i tre si incontrano nuovamente. Sceneggiatura dello stesso Scola, con Age & Scarpelli, breve cameo di Vittorio De Sica, scomparso prima dell’uscita del film nelle sale.

Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Ma Viviana e Modesto non sono una coppia, almeno ufficialmente. Tratto dall’omonimo romanzo di Diego De Silva, autore della sceneggiatura con il regista Alessio Maria Federici.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Poor Mimi! Her normally beautiful garden is all messy and full of swirly piles of earth. She's really upset and Jess promises to her help her make it the most beautiful garden ever! Raking away the swirls doesn't work, they just come back! Jess and Mimi realise that worms are making the swirly piles of earth. Mimi wants to move them away but they go back underground before she can catch them. When it rains the worms come back and Jess and Mimi gather up the worms in a bucket and take them to live in the orchard by a patch of scrappy flowers. The garden still isn't looking at it's best though! After the worms have gone Mimi's flowers go all droopy. Willow explains that worms make help make the soil rich and good for plants – and that's what makes the flowers bloom. Jess remembers that the worms had come out when it rained. They water the ground to bring the worms up to the surface again. The worms agree to come back to Mimi's garden and soon her garden is beautiful again. Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess and the pups have been looking after the orchard while Willow's been on holiday but the day she's due back the orchard is full of little piles of earth. What's making them? That's the Big Question. Jess wonders if someone put them there. He asks Mimi, who's making a pile of earth while she digs a hole. She tells him she's going to plant an apple tree. Maybe someone's been planting new apple trees in the orchard thinks Jess. But when he looks carefully there are no holes or newly planted trees. Horace the hoppy frog suggests that maybe it's an invisible digger who's digging underground. Billie the little mouse arrives and tells Jess that the little piles of earth are called molehills. Jess works out that the piles of earth are in a line. Maybe someone is digging a tunnel underground so they can travel right across the orchard. They keep very quiet and a tiny mole pops out above ground. That's who's been making piles of earth in the orchard. They've answered the question. Hooray!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: One winter morning Jess finds lots of ladybird in his barn. Why are they there? That's the Big Question! Mimi tells him that she has lots of ladybirds in her garden in the summer. They're always hungry and brilliant for the plants because they eat all the greenfly. Maybe they're looking for greenfly in his barn? Jess doesn't think so. There are no greenfly in the barn. He goes to ask Baa and Billie for help. They're saying goodbye to Little Bird who's flying away to a warmer country for the winter. Jess thinks maybe the ladybirds are gathering to fly away too and rushes back to his barn to say goodbye. But when he gets there he finds that the ladybirds are now all huddled together and fast asleep. What's going on? Jess goes to ask Willow and finds a hedgehog sleeping under some leaves near the stable. Willow explains that some animals find it hard to find food in the winter, especially if they can't store it, so they eat as much as they can and then go to sleep during the winter. It's called hibe.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Mimi's really upset with Little Bird who keeps eating all her lettuce seeds. Jess wonders how they can stop her. They try putting out extra food for her but Little Bird just eats everything! Jess wonders if covering the seeds with something so that Little Bird can't reach them would work. Mimi says it's a good idea but the sun won't reach the seeds either – which means they won't grow. The only thing that seems to stop t Little Bird is when she sees Jess and is frightened away. But Jess can't stand still in the vegetable patch forever! Willow sees him and tells him he's being a scarecrow. A scarecrow? Yes, something that scares away the birds. Mimi has a brilliant idea to make the perfect scarecrow. A Jess scarecrow. Little Bird stops eating the lettuce seeds and eats from the lovely bird table they put out for her instead. Hooray!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Baa and Billie have built a fantastic new see-saw in the meadow. Jess can't wait to have a go. But when he tries to make it go up and down with him on one end and Baa and Billie on the other he just gets stuck in the air and can't get the see saw down. ‘How can I go up and down on the see saw?' he asks? -desperate to have all the ‘up and down' fun he see the puppies having when they jump on the see-saw. Jess asks Horace the hoppy frog what he knows about ‘up and down', he talks to Willow about scales and weighing things until finally he works it out – if he finds someone roughly the same weight as him – balanced just like the puppies were - he'll do it! He works out that Mimi - of all his friends- weighs about the same as him and just as he worked out they jump on the see saw and go up and down, up and down and have a fantastic time! Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess shows Mimi his lovely Nature Collection. She really likes it and wonders what he's going to do with it. Now that's a good question! Jess thinks he'll display it but with the pups racing around it'd soon get damaged. He asks Horace if he could use it to make musical instruments, some things make a great sound but others aren't so good. It's time to go on a picnic with Mimi and his friends. Jess brings his Nature Collection along and when all his friends want to play a game Jess has a great idea. He's found the perfect thing to do with his Nature Collection! They can use them to make a funny obstacle course race. Brilliant!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: JESS and the pups give Baa a peach to eat, thinking it will make a change from grass. But the peach is too hard. How can I make my peach soft? Asks Jess. That's the Big Question! He asks Mimi and watches her kneading clay. She explains she's making the clay soft. Jess tries throwing the peach in the air to soften it but all it does is bruise. Horace tells them that the water in his pond keeps his skin soft so Jess and the pups try to soften the peach in water. But it's still hard. They visit Willow who offers the pups some of her lovely ripe cherries. She explains that the cherries went soft and changed colour when they ripened. Jess realises it's the same for the peach. He waits for it to ripen and then gives it to Baa. It's delicious! And now Jess knows how to make a peach soft. Yippety yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess, Mimi, Baa and Billie are playing a game, kicking a fir cone into a bucket. But it's so cold that poor shivering Billie can't kick properly. They need to find a way Bilie can stay warm enough. Baa's never cold because of his wool. They find a clump of Baa's wool on the ground but it just falls off Billie when Jess puts it on her – and Mimi tells them that glueing it on's a bad idea. What happens when it's summer and Billie wants to be cool? Maybe wrapping her in it, like a blanket, is the answer? It definitely keeps her warm - only problem is, she can't move! They realise that Baa wears a scarf as well. Perhaps they need a scarf for Billie? Mimi knits a tiny scarf for Billie, after twisting the clump of wool into yarn. It's perfect! Billie's toasty warm for their game of Flying Fircones. Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: JESS, JOEY and JINX go to the Whispering Woods in the hope of seeing some butterflies, but the puppies are so lively and noisy that they frighten them away. JESS wonders “how can we hide to watch butterflies?” That's the Big Question! JESS decides to make somewhere to hide out of natural materials. The puppies and Jess try to build a hide out of stones but they're too heavy and all fall down. Jess thinks that something lighter might work well but when they try to build a hide out of straw it's TOO light and flies away in the wind. JESS is stuck - there must be some other material on Greendale Farm they could use. But all that's around them are trees. Jess works out that trees are made out of wood and there are lots of old wooden apple crates in Willow's Stable which will do the job perfectly. JESS, JOEY and JINX build a butterfly hide out of wooden apple crates and soon see lots and lots of beautiful butterflies. Yippety yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: It's a snowy day on Greendale Farm so Jess and his friends have a race down Cherry Hill. Jess wants to win the race but he can't run as fast in the snow. “How can I go faster than Joey and Jinx?” Thinks Jess. That's the Big Question. First, Jess tries rolling down the hill like the puppies but he's not a good roller so that doesn't work. Horace shows Jess how he slides down his slide in the pond. Jess tries again at Cherry Hill but can't get going. Helped by Billie and Baa he remembers everything that Horace did - pushing off, going ‘Wheeeee! and lifting his legs up - but nothing works; he ends up sitting in the snow and not sliding at all. He needs something that will move on its own like Mimi's trolley! Jess tries sliding down the hill on the trolley but the wheels get stuck in the snow. Jess decides to take the wheels off and see if the trolley moves faster. Jess whizzes down the hill on the trolley top much faster than the rolling puppies. It's brilliant fun and he's answered the question. Yippety Ya.

programme.desc: It's Harvest time and Jess and his friends are having a special harvest breakfast. But all there is to eat is grass! Juicy and crunchy is fantastic, but it's still not perfect. “What about something chewy” suggests Willow. Jess remembers that he and Billie found some chewy oats on their way to the hazelnut tree. So he and Willow fetch some oats. It's tasty but it's still a bit dry – until Jess adds the final touch - some milk. Perfect! They've made delicious juicy-crunchy-chewy-mushy muesli! And what's more, Jess has answered his Big Question. Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess and Mimi are decorating hats. Mimi can't decide which of her two hats to wear – the one decorated with flowers or the one decorated with berries? It's a Big Question to answer! Baa and Billie are having fun making shadow shapes on the barn door so they go and ask them for advice. Jess suggests that he and Baa model the hats for Mimi. They look great but Mimi still doesn't know what they'd look like on her. JESS remembers the shadows that Baa was making earlier and suggests that she could wear a hat and look at her shadow to see what it looks like. Mimi tries it but she still can't see herself properly. It's just an outline. Undeterred, Jess suggests that they go and ask Horace for help. At the pond they meet the puppies who tel them about their new puppy friends who live in the pond. Jess realises that the puppies are looking at themselves reflected in the water. He realises that MIMI too may be able to see herself in the water. And of course she can! HORACE arrives and tell them that he's alway.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess shows us his little tree: a beautiful flowering shrub in full bloom. He tells us that his little tree didn't always look like this...there was a time when the tree's leaves turned yellow! What's happening to my little tree? That's the Big Question! Jess asks Mimi for help, but she's in bed with a bad cold. She's drinking lots of fluids to help make her better. Jess gives his little tree some more water to help make it better but when he goes to check on his tree the next day the leaves have turned brown and crinkly! Baa and Billie come along - Billie is tucked in the brim of Baa's woolly hat, it's too cold for her to come out. Jess wonders if his little tree is cold and needs warming up. So he wraps a potato sack round the little tree. But the next day things are even worse the leaves are falling off.! And it's happening all over Greendale Farm! Jess goes to see Horace who is busy composing a new song. It's all about the Seasons. Jess finally realises that what's happening to his tree is perfe.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: It's the day of Mimi's dance in Jess's barn but its too hot to move, let alone dance. Jess wonders how they can all keep cool! That's the BIG QUESTION. Jess asks his friends for ideas. Horace keeps cool by swimming under water, but that's no good for Jess and everyone else who can't swim. The puppies keep cool by panting, but that just makes Jess even hotter and out of breath. And Willow keeps cool by standing very still. That won't work for a dance, they can't all keep still! Mimi comes past holding a little fan which makes a lovely cool breeze. Jess realises that what they need is a giant fan that could make a cool breeze in the barn. He and Mimi make a huge fan which Horace works as part of his one-man band. Everyone has a great time dancing and keeping cool. Jess has answered the Question. Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess is looking after Horace's underwater friends in the pond whilst Horace is away. He sees a funny creature with a round head, a long tail and a little mark on his nose. “What's the funny little creature in the pond?” Hey! That's the Big Question! The creature has vanished so Jess describes it to Mimi who draws a picture of it. Mimi, Joey and Jinx think it must be a fish and name him Freddie, but Jess is not so sure. Time passes and Jess doesn't see Freddie again for ages. When he does spot him he's grown two back legs! Jess decides he needs a closer look using Billie's magnifying glass. They search for Freddie all round the pond. Baa thinks he's found him, but it turns out to be a newt, with four legs and spots on its back. At that moment a small frog jumps out onto a lily pad. It has the white mark on its nose just like Freddie but this is a frog! What's happened wonders Jess. Horace comes back and explains that frogs start out as tadpoles and gradually change, growing legs and losing their tail.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Horace has planned a big musical show but before it can start it begins raining and everyone runs for shelter. How can we keep dry? Asks JESS - that's the Big Question.
